## The FCA’s changing approach to MGAs [...] Insurance continues to account for the second largest share of complaints received by the FSPO (after Banking) with 2,142 insurance complaints in 2025. hits.title: Written evidence - CIM0040
hits.snippet: Insurance products represent a significant proportion of the complaints brought to the Financial Ombudsman. In 2025/26, we received around 214,600 new complaints, of which around 45,400 related to insurance. While we see complaints across a wide range of products, this response focuses on home and travel insurance, in line with the scope of the call for evidence. For home insurance, our analysis covers buildings insurance, contents insurance and home emergency insurance. Within these products, [...] The Financial Ombudsman’s casework provides a unique, evidence-based perspective on how the consumer insurance market is operating in practice. As this response highlights, we see many complaints about home and travel insurance, with recurring themes reflecting both the complexity of claims and the way products are understood and delivered. Our role in resolving disputes, and the insight we derive from them, supports the effective functioning of the wider regulatory framework. ## On this page [...] We see complaints about insurance pricing at various stages in a customer’s journey with their insurer.
